plan.goal: Doxorubicin dose-response on HepG2 spheroids (one spheroid per well, 96-well ULA plate) to determine cytotoxicity across a concentration series.
plan.rationale: HepG2 spheroids formed at 1000 cells/spheroid of 20 µm cells give a ~200 µm spheroid (solid-packing convention), at the upper limit for avoiding a necrotic core (O2 diffuses ~200 µm). One spheroid per well in a 96-well ULA plate with 100 µL working volume per well. Dose-response layout: 6 doxorubicin doses + 1 vehicle control = 7 conditions, 4 biological replicates per group (n=4 from sample-size calc for effect 50 / SD 25 at 80% power). Doxorubicin delivered from a 5 mM DMSO stock at 5 µM working concentration, giving 0.1% v/v DMSO (below the ~0.5% cytotoxic threshold).
caveats: Spheroid count (28 wells = 7 conditions × 4 replicates) is an assumption — adjust if your dose series or replicate plan differs; totals scale linearly.

1000 cells of 20 µm at solid packing ≈ 200 µm, at the necrotic-core threshold; real aggregates pack looser (~0.65-0.75), giving ~222 µm — verify spheroid diameter and consider 500-800 cells/spheroid if you want a smaller, fully oxygenated spheroid.
DMSO at 0.1% v/v is below the cytotoxic threshold, but include a vehicle-only control (already planned) to confirm no solvent effect.
Doxorubicin MW 543.52 g/mol is the HCl salt; confirm the exact salt form if you prepare the stock by mass.
Verify doxorubicin stability over the 48 h exposure and use fresh medium for dosing.

provenance.formula: n from two-sample t-test power equation
